name: Swiftfin Enhanced
subtitle: Swiftfin with real-time Anime4K Metal enhancement
description: An unofficial personal Swiftfin fork that follows Jellyfin upstream and adds an iOS/iPadOS Enhanced player with source-FPS frame pacing plus a background-safe playback sleep timer. Builds are produced automatically from public source code.

apps.name: Swiftfin Enhanced
apps.subtitle: Jellyfin playback with Anime4K Metal enhancement
apps.localizedDescription: An unofficial build of Swiftfin for iPhone and iPad. It retains Swiftfin's Jellyfin experience and adds an optional AVPlayer-based Anime4K Metal enhancement pipeline with source-FPS frame pacing, bounded processing buffering, automatic performance throttling, safety fallbacks, A/B comparison, a performance monitor, and a background-safe playback sleep timer.
